summary: Esper aikido control that dumps its own life to draw, swaps totals with the leader, then drains the table off Cabal Coffers.

tags.name: aikido
tags.reason: Fogs, Sokrates, taxes, and Settle the Wreckage turn other players' attacks into defense, cards, or a Batwing Brume drain.

tags.name: life exchange
tags.reason: Mirror Universe, Magus of the Mirror, Soul Conduit, Axis of Mortality, Mister Negative, and Repay in Kind are the namesake package.

tags.name: lifedrain
tags.reason: Exsanguinate, Debt to the Deathless, and Drain Life are the win conditions, backed by Queza and Psychosis Crawler.

tags.name: control
tags.reason: Eight counterspells, instant-speed removal, and a draw-go posture defend the engine until the drain turn.

tags.name: life paying
tags.reason: Wall of Blood, Selenia, Hatred, Necrologia, Dark Confidant, and the pain lands intentionally dump life before an exchange.

tags.name: pillow fort
tags.reason: Baird, Archangel of Tithes, Pendrell Mists, and Lady Evangela herself make attacking into this deck unattractive.

tags.name: politics
tags.reason: Sokrates, Promise of Loyalty, Council's Judgment, and Soul Conduit let the table's own choices decide who takes damage.

tags.name: big mana
tags.reason: Cabal Coffers, Crypt Ghast, Nirkana Revenant, Magus of the Coffers, and Bubbling Muck build the black mana the finishers need.

tags.name: counterspells
tags.reason: Blue exists in the deck specifically so the exchange or the drain cannot be answered at low life.

tags.name: draw
tags.reason: The deck refuses tutors and finds its finishers by drawing, mostly by paying life for cards.

tags.name: ramp
tags.reason: Rocks, land search, and Swamp doublers are all pointed at casting a lethal X spell.

tags.name: turbo fog
tags.reason: Seven instant-speed fogs plus Kami of False Hope and a repeatable commander prevention ability.

tags.name: x spells
tags.reason: Exsanguinate, Debt to the Deathless, Drain Life, Hatred, Necrologia, and Blue Sun's Zenith all scale with the mana engine.

tags.name: blink
tags.reason: Ephemerate and Ghostly Flicker exist to repeat Mister Negative's exchange and Mulldrifter.

tags.name: combo
tags.reason: Rings of Brighthearth with Deserted Temple or Magus of the Coffers scales black mana arbitrarily, but it is a mana engine rather than the primary plan.

tags.name: lands matter
tags.reason: Urborg and Blanket of Night make every land a Swamp so Cabal Coffers and Cabal Stronghold count higher.

tags.name: lifegain
tags.reason: Absorb, Necromancer's Covenant, and the drains refill the life total that the payment suite spends.

tags.name: stax
tags.reason: Pendrell Mists is the only symmetric upkeep tax.

tags.name: tokens
tags.reason: Inkshield and Necromancer's Covenant make incidental bodies.
